result: A review of optimization for large-scale machine learning centred on stochastic gradient: on nonconvex objectives a fixed step drives the average squared gradient only to a noise floor proportional to the step, while diminishing steps drive it to zero; noise reduction and second-order methods are the two ways to do better.
result_plain: Review of SG and its variants: fixed steps give a noise floor, diminishing steps convergence; noise reduction and second-order methods improve on SG.
